summary: U Power Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into subscription agreements for a private placement of 15,670,737 Class A ordinary shares at $1.64 per share for aggregate proceeds of $25.7 million under Regulation S. The board approved the transaction; founder CEO Jia Li subscribed for $3.0 million, reviewed by the audit committee as a related-party transaction. Closing is expected on April 28, 2026. Proceeds will fund hydrogen energy expansion in Thailand and overseas battery-swapping initiatives. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
